subject: Clarify prioritization: ClarityPay prompt-redact + purge API (deal-driven ask)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify prioritization: ClarityPay prompt-redact + purge API (deal-driven ask)

Team —

Quick ask: ClarityPay (prospect -> closing) has made a hard requirement in their security review: an API we can call to (1) redact sensitive fields at prompt-ingest time (configurable rules per-tenant), and (2) perform an on-demand purge (delete tokens, embeddings, and related KV cache for a tenant) with an audit trail and exportable proof. They want this in the initial go-live window tied to our contract (timeline below).

Why this matters now:
- ARR at close: ~$1.2M ARR first-year commitment if we can deliver a reasonable EAP within 6 weeks of PO.
- Legal/security: ClarityPay needs an auditable purge capability for regulatory compliance. Without it legal will hold the PO.
- Competitive: they evaluated 3 providers; this is a gating capability.

What I'm asking from Product & Eng:
- Can we prioritize an MVP in the next sprint cycle (target: deliverable/instrumented EAP within 4–6 weeks)?
- Proposed MVP scope: admin-triggered purge job (per-tenant), per-route prompt redaction middleware with rule set config (simple key/value and regex rules), and an exportable audit record (who/when/what deleted).
- Acceptance criteria: documented API, single-tenant purge completes within SLA (TBD), audit export generated as CSV/JSON, and minimal perf regression for other tenants.

Attachments: spec stub (claritypay-prompt-redact-spec-v0.2.pdf) and their security questions.

I know this is asking a lot. If we can scope to a narrow MVP (admin purge + basic redaction + audit export) that's more likely to happen fast. Please reply with feasibility, rough estimate, and blockers. Aditya is looping legal/finance on contract language if we flag EAP/fast-track.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Clarify prioritization: ClarityPay prompt-redact + purge API (deal-driven ask)

Naomi — thanks for the clear summary and the spec. A few clarifying questions from a product scope POV before I pull in the rest of the PM org: 

1) Single-tenant vs platform feature: do we need this built as a one-off for ClarityPay (fast track) or as a generalized capability we can support for other enterprise accounts? If the former, we can push a narrower, expedited implementation; if the latter we should scope for configuration, UX for rules, and policy management.

2) Purge semantics: do they require cryptographic deletion guarantees (e.g., overwriting underlying storage) or is logical deletion + audit acceptable for their legal team? The spec is a little ambiguous here.

3) EAP expectations: will ClarityPay accept an API that requires SRE/Eng-run purge jobs for the first release, or do they need a self-service console?

From a timeline standpoint, I agree the MVP you outlined looks reasonable for a focused 3–4 week engineering push if we keep it non-generalized and accept an operator-run purge initially. If we need to harden deletion semantics and multi-tenant UX, that pushes to 8–10 weeks.

I can sketch a PM plan and acceptance criteria today — Marcos (Markus) can you comment on rough eng effort? Also flagging potential dependency: audit/export will touch telemetry/console export infra.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Product Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarify prioritization: ClarityPay prompt-redact + purge API (deal-driven ask)

Naomi / Kim —

Tech thoughts from infra/serving side: first, the ask is doable but has non-trivial implications for runtime caches and our embeddings store. Quick breakdown: 

- Purge: we can build an admin-triggered purge flow that (a) marks tenant data for deletion, (b) kicks a background job to remove embeddings and tokenized prefixes from the KV/DB, and (c) emits an immutable audit record. For the MVP we can perform logical deletion + tombstone and clear in the background; that will be the fastest path (ETA: 3 sprints with 2 engineers + 1 infra SRE for job orchestration and testing).

- Prompt redaction middleware: implementing regex-based rule application at ingest time is straightforward, but we need to be careful about latency — we should run the middleware asynchronously in the ingest path (apply pre-tokenization), and fall back to blocking only for matches flagged as high-sensitivity. That adds ~5–8ms p95 in worst case for affected routes (rough estimate).

- Audit/export: we can reuse the existing export pipeline; we'll need a small schema extension to capture purge deltas and operator identity. That's ~1 sprint of work in telemetry/console infra.

MVP recommendation: limit to operator-triggered purge + basic regex redaction rules + audit export. This can be delivered in ~3–4 sprints if we prioritize and accept an operator-run flow (we'll need one eng and partial SRE/infra support locked for the window).

Risks/Blockers:
- If legal requires cryptographic destruction or immutable proof-of-deletion, that is heavier and will add 2–3 sprints.
- We need product confirmation on configuration surface (API only vs console + API).

If PM signs off on operator-run MVP, I can carve initial tickets and pair with SRE.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks Kim/Markus — helpful breakdown. Two additional data points from legal/procurement:

- ClarityPay's legal has said PO will sign only if an operator-invokable purge + audit is in the contract as a deliverable within 6 weeks. They won't require cryptographic overwrite for the initial release, but they will ask for signed acceptance that the purge process will be documented and verifiable.
- Sales ask: can we lock one eng + one PM as a fast-track team and treat this as a sprint-level priority? Aditya is willing to negotiate a short-term success fee / EAP addendum if that helps.

For decisioning: Naomi -> Product: Can you accept operator-run MVP with scope aligned to Markus's recommendation and target delivery in 4 weeks (operator-triggered purge + basic redaction + audit export)? If Product/Eng can commit, I'll push legal/procurement to close the PO and provide the EAP signature.

Short timeline: 
- 06/01: Product & Eng agree to scope and resource allocation
- 06/07: Engineering kickoff / ticketing
- 06/28: EAP deliverable for ClarityPay (internal test + docs)

Please confirm by EOD so I can escalate contract team.

Best —
Naomi

Naomi / Redwood team —

ClarityPay legal confirms that logical deletion + verifiable audit trail is sufficient for our initial go-live; we will reserve the right to request stronger deletion guarantees in a later phase.

We are prepared to sign a short EAP addendum and provide access to a small sandbox tenant for testing. Timing is tight for our compliance board, so we appreciate anything you can do to expedite.

Best,
